Results.ReviewText: Great product! Perfect for summer barbecues and makes great grill marks
Results.Title: Very happy with our purchase

Results.ReviewText: Great airflow provides the temperature control you need. The lid hook and hinged grill grate make grilling easy. I really enjoy this grill.
Results.Title: A Great Grill

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for sharing your honest feedback regarding the ash catcher design. We will be sure to share your comments with our team for consideration. If you need immediate assistance please reach out  to us direct. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: No issue with the grill. The catch can is a problem. Horrible design. AVOID  BUYING THIS GRILL. The levers are a real pain. You cannot release the can without getting on your knees and trying to adjust and release the can. If you’re lucky you won’t spill the contents on the ground. REPEAT FOR THE MONEY THIS GRILL IS A FAILURE
Results.Title: Horrible Catch Can Design

Results.ReviewText: Long time Weber grill owner, Kettle, Smoker, Gas grills.  As expected from Weber.  Four stars because the second handle provided on my earlier grills is not on this grill.  Grill comes with one handle not two..
Results.Title: Good grill.

Results.ReviewText: Purchased this from Amazon a few weeks ago. The lid was dented on the side and porcelain was chipped, so I had it replaced. The second one was also chipped and amazon wouldn’t let me replace it, only return it. I wanted to keep the grill so I reached out to the customer service with pictures of the damage, and they immediately sent a new lid. I received it through fedex in flawless condition. So far I’ve cooked a rotisserie chicken and pizza with attachments. I’m currently smoking some ribs watching the temperature stay steady with the smallest adjustments. Great grill and customer service!
Results.Title: Best customer service. Great grill.

Results.ReviewText:
This is my third Weber Kettle Grill.  I could not find a lid for sale.  Contacted Customer Service for a parts number. Discovered, instead, that it was under warranty.  WOW.   

Thank you,
Results.Title: Warranty

Results.ReviewText: Weber is still designing and building a quality product. I particularly like the ash catcher
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText:
My roofer replaced my 22 inch kettle Weber after a self sticking roll Roofing fell off the roof, and took out my grill!
Putting it together as Easy. That the instructions mentioned a plastic cap, or cover, that goes over the vent on the top of the kettle, to prevent burning yourself. I didn’t get that in my box.
Love the cooker, very pricey but still good. But hate the cart, so cheap and wobbly, Weber you can do better for the price
Results.Title: Great cooker terrible cart

Results.ReviewText: Nice little smoking system after being use to using larger smokers.  Really good for small smokes!
Results.Title: Classy Smoker

Results.ReviewText: recently moved it's been my go to grill for over 50 years. Weber makes quality products. gas and charcoal
Results.Title: quality products

Results.ReviewText: I love this Grill I started using it about a month ago and I really enjoyed grilling with charcoal . it's is definitely worth the money The thermometer is a big plus as well as the holders for my girl tongs. This device seems like it is built to last for years to come.
Results.Title: Worth every penny

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for providing your feedback. We are so sorry to hear your lid arrived damaged and the replacement is on back order. The current lid can be used till the replacement arrives. If you need immediate assistance please reach out to us direct. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: The lid arrived damaged and there is no more lids available.
Results.Title: Lid damage

Results.ReviewText: I had been wanting this grill for years and was finally able to purchase one. It was such a great purchase and I’m so satisfied with the quality and the food this grill cooks every single time. The grill does matter and Weber is a great way to go. I would recommend this grill to anyone who consistently wants great tasting food time after time.
Results.Title: So Glad

Results.ReviewText: Nice Simple Grill with lot of accessory option to make every cook tasty
Results.Title: Good beginner Grill

Results.ReviewText: Ive been a fan of Weber for many years. I bought this Kettle premium to replace my previous weber kettle which rusted out after about 9 years. It's hard to beat the kettle. So versatile. I use it for direct and indirect grilling mostly. Charcoal steaks, chicken, pork, sausage, veggies, pizza, you name it. Will likely buy another one when this one bites the dust.
Results.Title: Kettle

Results.ReviewText: 5-star cooker, I have owned several grills in my life but all things reliable lead back to the weber kettle.
Results.Title: Love my grill

Results.ReviewText: We have always owned a 22" Weber Kettle and prefer the real charcoal grilling all year long. Our old 22 was great but the ash sweep had rusted out and the replacement was just never right.
Results.Title: Great Replacement Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Everything has been perfect for 4 yrs til the ash shifter broke.
Results.Title: Warranty protection and great taste

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for providing your feedback. We are so sorry for the delay with your order. Our Care team is checking into this and will be reaching out to follow up soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Honestly I’m sure the grill is amazing. We had one a few years ago that we sold when we moved. However, I can’t really review it because although I ordered it on August 28, and although I was told it ships within 24-48 business hours, I have YET to receive this grill. It’s not September 20. I have reached out to the company MULTIPLE times asking about this, and I keep getting the same “we’ll have an update in 24-48 hours.” Don’t worry though, they made sure to charge my card even though they haven’t shipped the item.  I may update this review once I get the actual grill, but at this point I would say don’t bother ordering through this website unless you never want to actually see the item.
Results.Title: Wouldn’t know how the grill really is…

Results.ReviewText: When you demand solid heat, charcoal is best, and it is at its best when using the Weber Grill.  I love the porcelain finish color, love the built in thermometer and the practical ash catching receptical is a thing of beauty.
Results.Title: Grilling like a Superstar

Results.ReviewText: grill arrived with a dent in the lid.  Weber quickly sent another lid!  I was very happy with the customer service.
Results.Title: Shipping dent

Results.ReviewText: Grew up using charcoal grills, then switched to gas.  Great grill to bring back memories and to grill up some great food.
Results.Title: Nice grill.

Results.ReviewText: I love love love this grill!! I still really enjoy my 2004 genesis but, being 50 now it’s amazing how much more patience I have😂😂 I really enjoy planning recipes for it too. Coming from the gas grill(saving for a summit) it’s been a fun learning experience and Weber has all the tips and tricks you need. I started small with just burgers and dogs but after a couple of months I’m doing 4-6 hour cooks! Way less intimidating than I thought, and Weber has emails great recipes to try along with exact instructions. Great company with great products and great customer service!!!
Results.Title: Starting to outwork my 2004 genesis

Results.ReviewText: Taught me temperature control while smoking. Don't have a lot of accessories due to being on SSDI .
Results.Title: I own one and grill or smoke 3 times a week

Results.ReviewText: This is the perfect grill coals stay hot and burn for a long time
Results.Title: Perfect Grill

Results.ReviewText: I've been enjoying the Kettle Premium for the last month. The 22in size is plenty of room for my family cookouts, and I find the build quality and value to be great. I look forward to using this grill for years. I came to use the Kettle after nearly a decade of using a charcoal barrel with offset firebox. While that had more space, it seemed to lose heat much faster and was more difficult to lock temperature in.
Results.Title: Enjoying the kettle premium

Results.ReviewText: Love it!   I haven’t used charcoal in over twenty years.  I’ve used gas grills, wood coal cookers and my bbq pit and wanted to give charcoal another try.  I wanted the flavor I remember as a kid.   I have used my 22” kettle for chicken, burgers, pork chops, pork loin, meat loaf, squash, zucchini, asparagus, potatoes, corn and even blackberry cobbler.   I have been extremely pleased with how well the charcoal lasts and how precise I can keep the temperature.    This has been more fun to cook complete meals and keep the heat out of the house.  Another Weber success!
Results.Title: Beat my expectations

Results.ReviewText: I’ve been trying cooking on a Weber grill for 35 years. Both 22” kettles were outstanding. I decided to buy replace my 26 year old one with a new one. After waiting 6 weeks, the warranted replacement arrived. After installation, once again, the lid didn’t seat properly. After measuring, was 1/2” out of round. You quality control has gone downhill considerably. This will be the last Weber I will ever buy.
Results.Title: I will never recommend or purchase Weber products

Results.ReviewText: I would like to move the fire up and down. To control the heat.
Results.Title: Movable fire to control the heat better.

Results.ReviewText: I use 2 baskets for indirect grilling. One does not stay lit! Thinking of returning my new 22in Premium Weber for a refund!
Results.Title: Charcoal baskets ?

Results.ReviewText: Catch basket is great simple to use Nobody Beats a Weber..
Results.Title: Best Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: Arrived on time and packaged well. Instructions were easy to follow and it took no more than an hour to set up by myself.
Results.Title: Weber Premium

Results.ReviewText: The true American grilling experience with this large surface grill. There’s nothing like the flavor imparted to your meal with charcoal and the Weber has made it their science. I love the whole experience from prep to cleaning. It’s a real love of grilling.
Results.Title: All American Grill Experience

Results.ReviewText: We absolutely love our Weber grill! It is surprisingly easy to move around, super convenient for any occasion, and heat distribution is spot on every single time. The classic design gives you that unbeatable charcoal flavor with total temperature control, and the built-in ash catcher makes cleanup virtually effortless. Whether we are doing a quick weeknight cookout or taking our time grilling over the weekend, it performs like a champ. It's just an awesome piece.
Results.Title: An Absolute Game Changer! Reliable, Convenient

Results.ReviewText: Great classic product. Easy to operate and clean. Cannot go wrong.
Results.Title: Classic Grilling

Results.ReviewText: Finally bought one after years of having the expensive combo ultra cool grills. This is back to basics. This is what your father grilled on, and now we know why. I can sear, smoke, bake, roast... everything. Never going back. In fact, I'm about to start collecting Kettle accessories. 👀
Results.Title: The GOAT

Results.ReviewText: This grill is awesome. Once you set the temperature it stays there the entire cook. Great for beginners to bbq
Results.Title: Awesome purchase!!!! Will recommend!

Results.ReviewText: Best grill ever. I was on a crew that spotted box cars at the original plant in Arlington Heights in the 70s. Even got a replacement lid that was stolen from the original plant!
Results.Title: Favorite Grill

Results.ReviewText: I purchased my first Weber in 1979 so I'm not sure how many I have had but you can tell they are not as good as they use to be. They don't last as long as they use to. This new one has a very flimsy ash bucket and it does not fit very well. I wish I had kept the old bucket. It was a much heavier metal. The bottom line is I will always cook on a Weber. It's too bad it's not made as well.
Results.Title: It ain't what it use to be.

Results.ReviewText: We love it. Although we love our gas Weber grill cooking with charcoal is definitely the best.
Results.Title: We love it.

Results.ReviewText: Beautiful looking grill and heats up fast.  Like the built in thermometer and the ashes can below.
Results.Title: Great traditional charcoal grill

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
